properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 29 at 10:07PM CDT until September 29 at 11:00PM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
properties.description:
TORAMA

The National Weather Service in Amarillo has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
North central Randall County in the Panhandle of Texas...
West central Carson County in the Panhandle of Texas...
Southeastern Potter County in the Panhandle of Texas...

* Until 1100 PM CDT.

* At 1007 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a
tornado was located over Amarillo, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Amarillo and Pantex.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

CMAMtext: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 11:00 PM CDT. Take shelter now. Check media.

properties.description:

was located 11 miles northwest of Washburn, or 13 miles northeast of
Amarillo, moving northeast at 25 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without

to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree damage is

western Carson and southeastern Potter Counties.

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 29 at 10:54PM CDT until September 29 at 11:00PM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
properties.description:
The storm which prompted the warning has weakened below severe
limits, and no longer appears capable of producing a tornado.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.  However, heavy
rain is still possible with this thunderstorm.

NWSheadline: THE TORNADO WARNING FOR WESTERN CARSON AND SOUTHEASTERN POTTER COUNTIES WILL EXPIRE AT 1100 PM CDT
